row:
Welcome to Stonewall Productions and Films, which DARES to tell the stories that need to be told!  We fearlessly and without compromise  advocate for both animal rights and human rights issues - bringing to light the huge abhorant injustice and crimes committed against the most vulnerable, who cannot speak fir themselves - - this is their portal to the world to be heard!

 This is also the home of NZAJP (New Zealand Animal Justice Party ) which will be constantly  unrelenting in our political fight for their rights! Please join the revolution to stop animal slavery and exploitation by joining our political party here! www.nzajp.nz

Thank you for your huge support of the stories that need to be told, to help raise the level of consciousness to take a stand against the injustices happening to our most vulnerable!
